metodo.1.d: A proposal with named deliverables, acceptance criteria and what is out of scope. Nothing starts before that is signed.

priv.lead: This policy describes which personal data barros.no collects, what for, for how long, and what you can demand about it.
qual.1.d: To deliver work the client can use, defend and audit. That means scope written before work starts, deliverables with acceptance criteria, deadlines with a named owner, and documented correction when something departs from what was agreed. Client satisfaction is measured, not assumed.
qual.2.d: Measurable objectives, reviewed in the annual management review (ISO 9001, 9.3):
qual.3.d: The cycle below applies to all contracted work, regardless of which practice executes it.
qual.3a.d: Before proposing, we check whether we have the technical capacity and the availability to deliver. When we do not, we say so and point to an alternative. The proposal describes named deliverables, acceptance criteria, scope exclusions, timeline, contracting format and price.
qual.3b.d: Every project has a schedule with dated milestones, a named owner per deliverable, a risk matrix with owners, and a defined status meeting cadence. Material deviations are reported as soon as they are identified.
qual.3c.d: No deliverable reaches the client without being checked against the agreed acceptance criteria. The check is recorded and available to the client on request.
qual.3d.d: When a deliverable does not meet the criteria it is held, corrected and resubmitted — or, if correction is not feasible within the deadline, the client is informed of the alternative and its impact before the milestone falls due.
qual.3e.d: Documented handover, knowledge transfer to the client's team, formal satisfaction assessment and a record of lessons learned.
qual.4.1: How to log it: through the contact form, starting the message with the word «complaint», or by email to post@barros.no.
qual.4.2: Acknowledgement: the complaint receives a registration number and is acknowledged in writing within 2 business days.
qual.4.3: Analysis: root cause identified, immediate correction applied and a corrective action defined with a deadline and an owner.
qual.4.4: Closing: written reply to the complainant within 15 calendar days, stating what was done and what changed in the process.
qual.4.5: Records: complaints and corrective actions are retained for 5 years as documented information.
qual.4.d: Anyone can log a complaint — client, supplier or training participant.
qual.5.1: Single source: header, footer, service catalogue and institutional text exist in one master file; published pages are generated from it.
qual.5.2: Traceability: every published change corresponds to a versioned record in the repository, with author, date and a description of the change.
qual.5.3: Master language: Brazilian Portuguese. Translations are derived and identified as such; in case of divergence, the Portuguese text prevails.
qual.5.4: Review: institutional and legal content is reviewed at least annually.
qual.5.d: Every public document on this site — including this page — carries, in its footer, the document code, the version and the date of the last revision. The rules are:
qual.6.d: Each front is led by someone who holds the credential to lead it. Regulatory affairs and certification are led by a professional with a doctorate in the field; software development is executed by Digital Solutions, a company registered in Norway. The proposal always identifies which practice delivers each item. Where part of the work depends on third parties — a certification body, a sworn translator, a local office — that is stated before contracting.
qual.7.d: This site is built to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA: verified contrast, full keyboard navigation, visible focus, alternative text, semantic structure and respect for the reduced-motion preference. Accessibility failures are treated as nonconformities and enter the same corrective action flow described in item 4.
qual.8.d: Once a year, the indicators in item 2, the complaints in item 4 and the closing assessments are analysed together. That analysis produces the targets for the next cycle and the process changes, which take effect with a new version of this document.
qual.aviso.d: Barros is not, today, an ISO 9001 certified organisation — and no website can be certified against any standard. What this document states is different and verifiable: the service delivery processes described here were structured against the requirements of ISO 9001:2015, and the implementation of certifiable management systems is one of the services Inteligência Sanitária provides to clients. Any change to that status will be published on this page with the certificate number and the certification body.
qual.lead: This document describes how work is planned, executed, verified and corrected. It exists for two reasons: so the client knows what to demand, and so the practice has something to be audited against.

sobre.lead: The practice was born on the factory floor and in international logistics — Scania, Volvo, Ford — and reached the table where investment decisions are made. Today it brings together three fronts that rarely meet in a single consultancy: operations, technology and regulatory.
sobre.p.1: Operations and project manager with a career built in Norway, Brazil and Spain. The foundation is industrial: Just-in-Time discipline, supply chain integrity and the ability to read a real operation — the one that exists, not the one in the seller's spreadsheet.
sobre.p.2: On that foundation came a specialisation in public policy management at ENAP, project management training at BI Norwegian Business School and hands-on data analysis in Python, now applied to the decision dashboards Digital Solutions builds.
sobre.p.3: He is also founder and editor of Boreal Times, a publication that turns geopolitical and commodity movements into something useful for people who decide. The editorial habit — check, verify, attribute the source — is the same one behind every opinion delivered to a board.
sobre.titulo: Thirty years between the production line and the boardroom.
